title: Cincinnati coach Scott Satterfield has been hearing from NFL teams about Brendan Sorsby

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Cincinnati coach Scott Satterfield has been hearing from NFL teams about Brendan Sorsby
sources.description: With quarterback Brendan Sorsby heading to the NFL (if the NFL lets him into the supplemental draft), the question becomes whether he'll be drafted and, if so, the round in which he'll be selected.
